question: The Rourkela steel plant was set up in collaboration with Germany in which state of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Rourkela steel plant **is located in the **Sundargarh district** of **Odisha.**
 
• It was set up in collaboration with the **German company Krupp and Demag **in **1955.**
 
• The plant has an annual production capacity of **4.5 million tonnes **of hot metal and **4.2 million tonnes** of crude steel.
 
• The Rourkela steel plant is one of the** largest steel plants in India **and is a major contributor to the economy of Odisha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jharkhand:**

 
 
• Jharkhand was **carved out of Bihar** in the year **2000.**
 
• The steel industry is one of the major industries in Jharkhand, with companies like** Tata Steel, Bokaro Steel Plant, and Jindal Steel and Power Limited** operating in the state.
 
 
 
• **Bihar:**
 
 
• Bihar is a state in **eastern India** and was part of the undivided state of Bihar and Orissa during the time when the Rourkela steel plant was set up.
 
• The state has a **few small steel plants**, but not as significant as the Rourkela steel plant.
 
 
 
• **Assam: **
 
 
• Assam is a state in** northeastern India** and is not known for its steel industry.
 
• The state has a few small-scale steel plants, but they ar**e not as** significant as the Rourkela steel plant.
